cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.14)
project(reverie_private_loader_errno C)
set(DynamoRIO_USE_LIBC ON)
find_package(DynamoRIO REQUIRED)
add_library(private_loader_errno_client SHARED client.c)
configure_DynamoRIO_client(private_loader_errno_client)
target_compile_options(private_loader_errno_client PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror -fno-builtin)
add_executable(private_loader_errno_guest guest.c)
target_compile_options(private_loader_errno_guest PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror -fno-builtin)
target_link_libraries(private_loader_errno_guest PRIVATE pthread)

add_library(private_loader_errno_wrong_provider SHARED client.c)
configure_DynamoRIO_client(private_loader_errno_wrong_provider)
target_compile_definitions(private_loader_errno_wrong_provider PRIVATE PRIVATE_ERRNO_WRONG_PROVIDER=1)
target_compile_options(private_loader_errno_wrong_provider PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror -fno-builtin)

# Exact malformed-input controls exercise both selected-symbol hash paths.
foreach(style gnu sysv)
  foreach(kind OBJECT NOTYPE NONEXEC)
    string(TOLOWER "${kind}" lower)
    set(target "private_errno_${lower}_${style}")
    add_library(${target} SHARED client.c)
    configure_DynamoRIO_client(${target})
    target_compile_definitions(${target} PRIVATE "PRIVATE_ERRNO_${kind}=1")
    target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror -fno-builtin)
    set_target_properties(${target} PROPERTIES PREFIX "" SUFFIX ""
      OUTPUT_NAME "libc.so.errno-${lower}-${style}")
    set_property(TARGET ${target} APPEND_STRING PROPERTY LINK_FLAGS " -Wl,--hash-style=${style}")
  endforeach()
endforeach()

set(DynamoRIO_USE_LIBC OFF)
add_library(private_loader_errno_no_libc SHARED client.c)
configure_DynamoRIO_client(private_loader_errno_no_libc)
target_compile_definitions(private_loader_errno_no_libc PRIVATE PRIVATE_ERRNO_NO_LIBC=1)
target_compile_options(private_loader_errno_no_libc PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror
  -fno-builtin -ffreestanding -fno-stack-protector)
